issue_context.title: Bond Fixture with Two Lights Not Working Properly
issue_context.body:
**The problem**

One of my Bond fans has two lights, a top and bottom, working completely fine in the Bond App. Home Assistant only sees this as one fan light, but traditionally turns both top and bottom lights on and off in unison. After updating Home Assistant, the Bond integration now only triggers the Top light and will not send any trigger to turn the bottom light on and off. 

**What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?**

**What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?**

review_comments:
Missing return value typing.

If this integration has almost complete typing coverage I'd recommend enforcing that in our CI by updating the config line in `setup.cfg`.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/66027bcef5a0f8d425ebb64ded7339eaa4fef72a/setup.cfg#L45

`is_on` compared with `self._light == 1`.

Python does indeed made `True` and `False` a subclass of `int` but it is confusing to rely on that in the code.
I prefer storing a boolean in `self._light`

Since the bond-api is returning `1` or `0` for these values it looks like the integration is using that convention in a few places.  

`light.py`
